final: SELECT city, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / total_count AS count_divided_by_sum, employee_count * 1.0 / average_count AS count_divided_by_average FROM (SELECT city, employee_count, SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(employee_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM (SELECT City AS city, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY City) AS city_counts) AS paired_rows ORDER BY city
